highlights: Google Drive is available for testing while Google reviews full My Drive access. Browse My Drive in either pane, edit files, and copy or move files and folders between Drive and your computer.
Join a Dirlume LAN group with one shared code to browse each member’s drives.
Find local folders, Dirlume LAN, and KSwitcher LAN in separate sections of the source menu.
Create, edit, copy, move, rename, and delete items in List and Tree on supported writable sources.
Copy nested folders from remote shares and resolve file conflicts in the transfer dialog.
Retry denied SFTP file operations with sudo after confirming.
Organize file references in named collections and open them from either pane.
Request Windows administrator consent when a DNS cache flush requires it.
